title: Sort inbox
prompt:
File every note in the inbox (list_inbox).
For each note decide what it is and file it:
- a task with a date → reminder_add (default 09:00 if no time)
- a deadline/key date → milestone_add
- a decision → decision_log
- a fact, idea or update about a project → project_log (and project_update nextStep if it changes the next step)
- a brand-new project idea → project_create
- work to do later → queue_followup (plan permission unless it clearly needs code)
Use hq_index to match notes to project slugs. Then inbox_remove the notes you filed. If a note is too vague, leave it in the inbox.
Final answer: one line per note: what it became.
